recognize_zh: 視野中可見多個核圓、染色質細緻、胞質深藍的芽細胞，旁邊有核分葉異常且顆粒稀少的顆粒球系細胞與核形不規則的紅血球前驅細胞；但單一視野中多系發育不良的程度有限，需結合全片計數判讀。
features: Several blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Hypogranular myeloid cell with abnormal nuclear lobation (upper center)
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
Scattered small lymphocytes and orthochromatic normoblasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with a hypogranular myeloid cell with abnormal nuclear lobation and erythroid precursors showing irregular nuclear contours. Small lymphocytes and late normoblasts are also present. The degree of multilineage dysplasia cannot be quantified from this single field. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic features, compatible with AML with myelodysplasia-related changes when blast count and lineage dysplasia criteria are met.

ddx.vs: Separated by blast percentage (<20% in MDS), which requires a 500-cell differential rather than a single field.
These lack ≥50% dysplasia in two or more lineages and MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes but no increase in blasts, and corrects with B12/folate.
